WITH RECURSIVE reward_input(seen_since,xp_amount) AS (SELECT ?,?), sources AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT p.id,p.hp,p.last_seen,p.movement_checked_at_ms,p.last_monster_hit_at,p.area,p.channel,p.arena_match_id,p.x,p.y FROM monster_participants mp JOIN players p ON p.id=mp.player_id
      JOIN monster_xp_claims c ON c.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND c.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND c.player_id=mp.player_id WHERE c.claim_token=?  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM normal_reward_claims r WHERE r.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND r.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND r.player_id=mp.player_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sinsi_reward_claims r WHERE r.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND r.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND r.player_id=mp.player_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM boss_reward_claims r WHERE (mp.monster_id='dunya-bosu-1' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM loadlab_boss_rounds_v1 lab_round WHERE lab_round.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND lab_round.boss_round=mp.spawn_round)) AND r.boss_round=mp.spawn_round AND r.player_id=mp.player_id)
    ),peers AS (
    SELECT source.id AS source_id,ally.id AS ally_id FROM sources source
    JOIN party_members mine ON mine.player_id=source.id
    JOIN party_members team ON team.party_id=mine.party_id AND team.player_id<>source.id
    CROSS JOIN players ally ON ally.id=team.player_id
    WHERE 1=1 AND source.hp>0 AND MAX(source.last_seen,CAST(source.movement_checked_at_ms/1000 AS INTEGER),CAST(source.last_monster_hit_at/1000 AS INTEGER))>=(SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input) AND ally.hp>0 AND MAX(ally.last_seen,CAST(ally.movement_checked_at_ms/1000 AS INTEGER),CAST(ally.last_monster_hit_at/1000 AS INTEGER))>=(SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)
    AND ally.area=source.area AND ally.channel=source.channel AND ally.arena_match_id=source.arena_match_id
    AND (ally.x-source.x)*(ally.x-source.x)+(ally.y-source.y)*(ally.y-source.y)<=5760000),
    buckets AS (SELECT s.id,COALESCE('party:'||pm.party_id,'solo:'||s.id) AS bucket FROM sources s LEFT JOIN party_members pm ON pm.player_id=s.id WHERE pm.party_id IS NULL OR(s.hp>0 AND MAX(s.last_seen,CAST(s.movement_checked_at_ms/1000 AS INTEGER),CAST(s.last_monster_hit_at/1000 AS INTEGER))>=(SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input))),
    recipients AS(SELECT bucket,id AS player_id FROM buckets UNION SELECT b.bucket,p.ally_id FROM peers p JOIN buckets b ON b.id=p.source_id),
    ranked AS(SELECT bucket,player_id,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY bucket) AS member_count,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY bucket ORDER BY player_id) AS member_rank FROM recipients),
    amounts AS(SELECT player_id,SUM(CAST((SELECT xp_amount FROM reward_input)*(100+2*(MIN(5,member_count)-1))/100 AS INTEGER)) AS amount FROM ranked GROUP BY player_id),
    boosted AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT p.id,ROUND(a.amount*(1+COALESCE((SELECT CASE s.active_level WHEN 1 THEN .05 WHEN 2 THEN .07 WHEN 3 THEN .15 ELSE 0 END FROM guild_skills s JOIN guild_members m ON m.guild_id=s.guild_id WHERE m.player_id=p.id AND s.active_until>unixepoch()*1000),0))*(CASE WHEN p.xp_ring_until>? THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END)*(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM player_pets WHERE player_id=p.id AND acquired_at+604800>unixepoch() AND equipped=1 AND kind='dog') THEN 1.2 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM player_pets WHERE player_id=p.id AND acquired_at+604800>unixepoch() AND equipped=1 AND kind IN ('bird','monkey')) THEN 1.1 ELSE 1 END)*(1+(COALESCE((SELECT CASE i.item_name WHEN 'Bilgelik Kemeri' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END FROM player_items i WHERE i.player_id=p.id AND i.kind='belt' AND i.equipped=1 AND i.rarity='crafted' AND i.power=0 AND i.role='all' AND i.enchantments='[]' AND i.expires_at_ms=0 AND i.premium_origin=0 LIMIT 1),0))/100.0)*(CASE WHEN p.halloween_candy_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END)*(CASE WHEN p.arena_exp_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.2 ELSE 1 END)*(CASE WHEN p.pumpkin_enabled499=1 AND p.pumpkin_until499>CAST(ROUND((julianday('now')-2440587.5)*86400000) AS INTEGER) THEN 1.25 WHEN p.radiant_enabled=1 AND p.radiant_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.2 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM player_items WHERE player_id=p.id AND kind='costume' AND equipped=1) THEN 1.2 ELSE 1 END)) AS amount FROM amounts a JOIN players p ON p.id=a.player_id),
    curve(level,total_xp,next_cost) AS(SELECT 1,0,CAST(json_extract((SELECT xp_curve_json FROM game_settings WHERE id=1),'$[0]') AS INTEGER)
    UNION ALL SELECT level+1,total_xp+next_cost,COALESCE(CAST(json_extract((SELECT xp_curve_json FROM game_settings WHERE id=1),'$['||level||']') AS INTEGER),0) FROM curve WHERE level<65)
    UPDATE players SET quest_kills438=MIN(1000000000,quest_kills438+1),battle_pass_xp=CASE WHEN players.area<>'afk' AND (CASE WHEN level>=65 AND rank_tier>0 THEN ROUND((SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)*(CASE WHEN players.wisdom_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END)) ELSE (SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id) END)>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM battle_pass_settings WHERE id=1 AND enabled=1 AND season_id<>'' AND starts_at<=(((SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)+30)*1000) AND ends_at>(((SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)+30)*1000)) THEN MIN((SELECT xp_cap FROM battle_pass_settings WHERE id=1),(CASE WHEN players.battle_pass_season=(SELECT season_id FROM battle_pass_settings WHERE id=1) THEN players.battle_pass_xp ELSE 0 END)+CAST((CASE WHEN level>=65 AND rank_tier>0 THEN ROUND((SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)*(CASE WHEN players.wisdom_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END)) ELSE (SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id) END) AS INTEGER)) ELSE players.battle_pass_xp END,battle_pass_season=CASE WHEN players.area<>'afk' AND (CASE WHEN level>=65 AND rank_tier>0 THEN ROUND((SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)*(CASE WHEN players.wisdom_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END)) ELSE (SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id) END)>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM battle_pass_settings WHERE id=1 AND enabled=1 AND season_id<>'' AND starts_at<=(((SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)+30)*1000) AND ends_at>(((SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)+30)*1000)) THEN (SELECT season_id FROM battle_pass_settings WHERE id=1) ELSE players.battle_pass_season END,rank_xp=CASE WHEN level>=65 AND rank_tier>0 THEN MIN(9000000000000,rank_xp+ROUND((SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)*(CASE WHEN players.wisdom_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END))) ELSE rank_xp END,xp=CASE WHEN level>=(CASE WHEN (SELECT expansion65_enabled FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)=1 OR (players.is_gm=1 AND players.id=(SELECT expansion65_preview_player_id FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)) THEN 65 ELSE 50 END) THEN xp ELSE MIN((SELECT total_xp FROM curve WHERE level=(CASE WHEN (SELECT expansion65_enabled FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)=1 OR (players.is_gm=1 AND players.id=(SELECT expansion65_preview_player_id FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)) THEN 65 ELSE 50 END)),xp+(SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)) END,level=MAX(level,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(level) FROM curve WHERE level<=(CASE WHEN (SELECT expansion65_enabled FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)=1 OR (players.is_gm=1 AND players.id=(SELECT expansion65_preview_player_id FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)) THEN 65 ELSE 50 END) AND total_xp<=xp+(SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)),1))
    WHERE id IN(SELECT player_id FROM monster_xp_claims WHERE claim_token=?) AND id IN(SELECT id FROM boosted) RETURNING id,xp,level,rank_xp

UPDATE players SET quest_kills438=kernel511_reward_value_r54('quest_kills438',id,xp,level,rank_xp,rank_tier,wisdom_until,is_gm,area,battle_pass_xp,battle_pass_season,quest_kills438),battle_pass_xp=kernel511_reward_value_r54('battle_pass_xp',id,xp,level,rank_xp,rank_tier,wisdom_until,is_gm,area,battle_pass_xp,battle_pass_season,quest_kills438),battle_pass_season=kernel511_reward_value_r54('battle_pass_season',id,xp,level,rank_xp,rank_tier,wisdom_until,is_gm,area,battle_pass_xp,battle_pass_season,quest_kills438),rank_xp=kernel511_reward_value_r54('rank_xp',id,xp,level,rank_xp,rank_tier,wisdom_until,is_gm,area,battle_pass_xp,battle_pass_season,quest_kills438),xp=kernel511_reward_value_r54('xp',id,xp,level,rank_xp,rank_tier,wisdom_until,is_gm,area,battle_pass_xp,battle_pass_season,quest_kills438),level=kernel511_reward_value_r54('level',id,xp,level,rank_xp,rank_tier,wisdom_until,is_gm,area,battle_pass_xp,battle_pass_season,quest_kills438) WHERE id IN(SELECT player_id FROM monster_xp_claims WHERE claim_token=?) AND id IN(SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) RETURNING id,xp,level,rank_xp

UPDATE players SET last_seen=MAX(last_seen,?) WHERE id=? AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM kernel511_channel_owners o
   JOIN kernel511_admissions a ON a.player_id=o.player_id AND a.channel=o.channel AND a.epoch=o.epoch
   JOIN kernel511_channel_processes p ON p.channel=o.channel AND p.incarnation=o.incarnation AND p.online=1
   WHERE o.player_id=players.id AND o.state='active' AND o.channel=? AND o.incarnation=? AND o.epoch=?)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO normal_reward_claims
         (monster_id, spawn_round, player_id, claim_token, awarded_at)
       SELECT mp.monster_id, mp.spawn_round, mp.player_id, ?, ?
       FROM monster_participants mp JOIN players p ON p.id = mp.player_id
       WHERE mp.monster_id = ? AND mp.spawn_round = ?
SELECT 'main' scope,name,sql FROM main.sqlite_schema WHERE type='trigger' UNION ALL SELECT 'temp',name,sql FROM temp.sqlite_schema WHERE type='trigger'

WITH reward_input(seen_since,xp_amount) AS (SELECT ?,?), sources AS (
      SELECT p.* FROM monster_participants mp JOIN players p ON p.id=mp.player_id
      WHERE mp.monster_id=? AND mp.spawn_round=?
      AND (? IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM monsters m WHERE m.id=mp.monster_id AND m.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND m.hp>0 AND m.hp<=?))
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM monster_xp_claims c WHERE c.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND c.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND c.player_id=mp.player_id)
       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM normal_reward_claims r WHERE r.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND r.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND r.player_id=mp.player_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sinsi_reward_claims r WHERE r.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND r.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND r.player_id=mp.player_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM boss_reward_claims r WHERE (mp.monster_id='dunya-bosu-1' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM loadlab_boss_rounds_v1 lab_round WHERE lab_round.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND lab_round.boss_round=mp.spawn_round)) AND r.boss_round=mp.spawn_round AND r.player_id=mp.player_id)
    ),peers AS (
    SELECT source.id AS source_id,ally.id AS ally_id FROM sources source
    JOIN party_members mine ON mine.player_id=source.id
    JOIN party_members team ON team.party_id=mine.party_id AND team.player_id<>source.id
    JOIN players ally ON ally.id=team.player_id
    WHERE 1=1 AND source.hp>0 AND MAX(source.last_seen,CAST(source.movement_checked_at_ms/1000 AS INTEGER),CAST(source.last_monster_hit_at/1000 AS INTEGER))>=(SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input) AND ally.hp>0 AND MAX(ally.last_seen,CAST(ally.movement_checked_at_ms/1000 AS INTEGER),CAST(ally.last_monster_hit_at/1000 AS INTEGER))>=(SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)
    AND ally.area=source.area AND ally.channel=source.channel AND ally.arena_match_id=source.arena_match_id
    AND (ally.x-source.x)*(ally.x-source.x)+(ally.y-source.y)*(ally.y-source.y)<=5760000)
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO monster_xp_claims(monster_id,spawn_round,player_id,claim_token,awarded_at)
    SELECT ?,?,id,?,? FROM(SELECT id FROM sources UNION SELECT ally_id FROM peers)

UPDATE player_items SET enchantments=CASE
  WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(enchantments) WHERE json_extract(value,'$.kind')='evolution_kills')
  THEN json_set(enchantments,(SELECT '$['||key||'].value' FROM json_each(enchantments) WHERE json_extract(value,'$.kind')='evolution_kills' LIMIT 1),
    MIN(1000000000,COALESCE((SELECT json_extract(value,'$.value') FROM json_each(enchantments) WHERE json_extract(value,'$.kind')='evolution_kills' LIMIT 1),0)+1))
  ELSE json_insert(enchantments,'$[#]',json_object('kind','evolution_kills','value',1)) END
  WHERE id=? AND player_id=? AND kind='weapon' AND equipped=1
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM monsters WHERE id=? AND spawn_round=? AND hp>0 AND hp<=? AND is_stone=0)

INSERT INTO pve_engagements
         (player_id, monster_id, spawn_round, next_hit_at_ms, expires_at_ms, hit_sequence, updated_at_ms, last_skill_at_ms,attackers489)
       SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?, ?, ? FROM players current_player
       WHERE current_player.id = ? AND current_player.hp > 0
         AND current_player.area = ? AND current_player.channel = ? AND current_player.arena_match_id = ?
         AND current_player.realtime_scope_version = ?
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monsters current_monster
           WHERE current_monster.id = ? AND current_monster.spawn_round = ? AND current_monster.hp > 0)
       ON CONFLICT(player_id) DO UPDATE SET
         attackers489 = CASE WHEN json_extract(CASE WHEN pve_engagements.attackers489='{}' THEN json_object(pve_engagements.monster_id,json_object('monster_id',pve_engagements.monster_id,'spawn_round',pve_engagements.spawn_round,'next_hit_at_ms',pve_engagements.next_hit_at_ms,'last_skill_at_ms',pve_engagements.last_skill_at_ms)) ELSE pve_engagements.attackers489 END,'$.'||json_quote(excluded.monster_id)||'.spawn_round')=excluded.spawn_round THEN CASE WHEN pve_engagements.attackers489='{}' THEN json_object(pve_engagements.monster_id,json_object('monster_id',pve_engagements.monster_id,'spawn_round',pve_engagements.spawn_round,'next_hit_at_ms',pve_engagements.next_hit_at_ms,'last_skill_at_ms',pve_engagements.last_skill_at_ms)) ELSE pve_engagements.attackers489 END
 WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(CASE WHEN pve_engagements.attackers489='{}' THEN json_object(pve_engagements.monster_id,json_object('monster_id',pve_engagements.monster_id,'spawn_round',pve_engagements.spawn_round,'next_hit_at_ms',pve_engagements.next_hit_at_ms,'last_skill_at_ms',pve_engagements.last_skill_at_ms)) ELSE pve_engagements.attackers489 END))<32 OR json_type(CASE WHEN pve_engagements.attackers489='{}' THEN json_object(pve_engagements.monster_id,json_object('monster_id',pve_engagements.monster_id,'spawn_round',pve_engagements.spawn_round,'next_hit_at_ms',pve_engagements.next_hit_at_ms,'last_skill_at_ms',pve_engagements.last_skill_at_ms)) ELSE pve_engagements.attackers489 END,'$.'||json_quote(excluded.monster_id)) IS NOT NULL
 THEN json_set(CASE WHEN pve_engagements.attackers489='{}' THEN json_object(pve_engagements.monster_id,json_object('monster_id',pve_engagements.monster_id,'spawn_round',pve_engagements.spawn_round,'next_hit_at_ms',pve_engagements.next_hit_at_ms,'last_skill_at_ms',pve_engagements.last_skill_at_ms)) ELSE pve_engagements.attackers489 END,'$.'||json_quote(excluded.monster_id),json_object('monster_id',excluded.monster_id,'spawn_round',excluded.spawn_round,'next_hit_at_ms',excluded.next_hit_at_ms,'last_skill_at_ms',excluded.last_skill_at_ms)) ELSE CASE WHEN pve_engagements.attackers489='{}' THEN json_object(pve_engagements.monster_id,json_object('monster_id',pve_engagements.monster_id,'spawn_round',pve_engagements.spawn_round,'next_hit_at_ms',pve_engagements.next_hit_at_ms,'last_skill_at_ms',pve_engagements.last_skill_at_ms)) ELSE pve_engagements.attackers489 END END,
         monster_id = CASE WHEN pve_engagements.expires_at_ms >= excluded.updated_at_ms
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monsters live_monster
      WHERE live_monster.id = pve_engagements.monster_id
        AND live_monster.spawn_round = pve_engagements.spawn_round AND live_monster.hp > 0) THEN pve_engagements.monster_id ELSE excluded.monster_id END,
         spawn_round = CASE WHEN pve_engagements.expires_at_ms >= excluded.updated_at_ms
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monsters live_monster
      WHERE live_monster.id = pve_engagements.monster_id
        AND live_monster.spawn_round = pve_engagements.spawn_round AND live_monster.hp > 0) THEN pve_engagements.spawn_round ELSE excluded.spawn_round END,
         next_hit_at_ms = CASE WHEN pve_engagements.expires_at_ms >= excluded.updated_at_ms
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monsters live_monster
      WHERE live_monster.id = pve_engagements.monster_id
        AND live_monster.spawn_round = pve_engagements.spawn_round AND live_monster.hp > 0)
           THEN MIN(pve_engagements.next_hit_at_ms, excluded.next_hit_at_ms) ELSE excluded.next_hit_at_ms END,
         expires_at_ms = CASE WHEN pve_engagements.expires_at_ms >= excluded.updated_at_ms
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monsters live_monster
      WHERE live_monster.id = pve_engagements.monster_id
        AND live_monster.spawn_round = pve_engagements.spawn_round AND live_monster.hp > 0)
           THEN MAX(pve_engagements.expires_at_ms, excluded.expires_at_ms) ELSE excluded.expires_at_ms END,
         last_skill_at_ms = CASE WHEN pve_engagements.expires_at_ms >= excluded.updated_at_ms
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monsters live_monster
      WHERE live_monster.id = pve_engagements.monster_id
        AND live_monster.spawn_round = pve_engagements.spawn_round AND live_monster.hp > 0) THEN pve_engagements.last_skill_at_ms ELSE excluded.last_skill_at_ms END,
         updated_at_ms = excluded.updated_at_ms
       RETURNING player_id

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO normal_defeats
               (monster_id, spawn_round, defeated_at, x, y, xp_reward, essence_min, essence_span,
                loot_source_key, loot_profile_revision, loot_profile_json, events_snapshot)
             SELECT id, spawn_round, ?, x, y, ?, ?, ?, ?,
               COALESCE((
                 SELECT version.revision FROM loot_profiles pointer JOIN loot_profile_versions version
                   ON version.source_key = pointer.source_key AND version.revision = pointer.active_revision
                 WHERE pointer.source_key = ? AND pointer.active_revision > 0
               ), 0),
               COALESCE((
                 SELECT version.profile_json FROM loot_profiles pointer JOIN loot_profile_versions version
                   ON version.source_key = pointer.source_key AND version.revision = pointer.active_revision
                 WHERE pointer.source_key = ? AND pointer.active_revision > 0
               ), ?), ?
             FROM monsters
             WHERE id = ? AND is_boss = 0 AND hp > 0 AND hp <= ? AND spawn_round = ?

UPDATE players SET attack_one_at = MAX(attack_one_at, ?) + ?,
           combat_lock_until_ms = MAX(combat_lock_until_ms, ?)
         WHERE id = ? AND hp > 0 AND stun_until_ms <= ? AND attack_one_at <= ?
           AND area = ? AND channel = ? AND arena_match_id = ? AND realtime_scope_version = ?
         RETURNING attack_one_at AS reserved_until
UPDATE players SET gems=gems+? WHERE id IN (SELECT player_id FROM normal_reward_claims WHERE claim_token=?)

AND id IN(SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) RETURNING id,xp,level,rank_xp

UPDATE players SET combat_lock_until_ms = MAX(combat_lock_until_ms, ?)
       WHERE id = ? AND hp > 0 AND area = ? AND channel = ? AND arena_match_id = ?
         AND realtime_scope_version = ?
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pve_engagements engagement
           WHERE engagement.player_id = players.id AND engagement.updated_at_ms = ?)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO guild_monster_claims(world_cycle,monster_id,spawn_round,guild_id)
 SELECT (SELECT cycle FROM world_state WHERE id=1),monster.id,monster.spawn_round,member.guild_id FROM monsters monster JOIN guild_members member ON member.player_id=?
 WHERE monster.id=? AND monster.spawn_round=? AND monster.hp>0 AND monster.hp<=? AND monster.is_stone=0
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO monster_xp_claims(monster_id,spawn_round,player_id,claim_token,awarded_at) SELECT ?,?,value,?,? FROM json_each(?)

DELETE FROM pve_engagements WHERE player_id = ? AND monster_id = ? AND spawn_round = ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(pve_engagements.attackers489) multi489 JOIN monsters live489 ON live489.id=multi489.key AND live489.spawn_round=json_extract(multi489.value,'$.spawn_round') WHERE live489.hp>0 AND live489.id<>pve_engagements.monster_id)
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monsters WHERE id = ? AND spawn_round = ? AND hp <= 0)

UPDATE monsters SET hp = MAX(0, hp - ?), last_damaged_at_ms = ?,
             wave_stage = CASE WHEN is_stone = 0 THEN wave_stage
               WHEN hp - ? <= 0 THEN 3
               WHEN hp - ? <= max_hp / 2 THEN MAX(wave_stage, 2)
               ELSE MAX(wave_stage, 1) END,
             respawn_at = CASE WHEN hp - ? <= 0 THEN ? ELSE respawn_at END,
             despawn_at = CASE WHEN hp - ? <= 0 AND is_boss = 1 THEN 0 ELSE despawn_at END
           WHERE id = ? AND hp > 0 AND spawn_round = ? RETURNING hp, wave_stage
INSERT INTO combat_events (player_id, target_id, role, ability, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

WITH drops(drop_row) AS (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
     INSERT OR IGNORE INTO world_drops
       (id, owner_id, monster_id, kind, item_name, rarity, power, amount, role, enchantments,
        x, y, expires_at, collectible_at)
     SELECT
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[0]') AS TEXT),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[1]') AS TEXT),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[2]') AS TEXT),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[3]') AS TEXT),
       json_extract(drop_row, '$[4]'),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[5]') AS TEXT),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[6]') AS INTEGER),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[7]') AS INTEGER),
       json_extract(drop_row, '$[8]'),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[9]') AS TEXT),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[10]') AS REAL),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[11]') AS REAL),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[12]') AS INTEGER),

    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM boss_reward_claims r WHERE (mp.monster_id='dunya-bosu-1' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM loadlab_boss_rounds_v1 lab_round WHERE lab_round.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND lab_round.boss_round=mp.spawn_round)) AND r.boss_round=mp.spawn_round AND r.player_id=mp.player_id)
